title: Rubric
description: Binary scoring rubric for one evaluation task.

task_id.description: Must match the 'id' field in the corresponding task YAML.

dimensions.description: Scoring dimensions; each is binary (pass or fail).

criterion.description: Exact, observable condition; must be automatable.

weight.description: Relative weight (all weights should sum to 1.0).

verification.description: Shell command or procedure used to verify this dimension.

disqualifying.description: If true, failing this dimension scores the entire submission 0.

difficulty_notes.description: Notes on how difficulty was calibrated (model attempts, removed ambiguities).

removed_criteria.description: Criteria removed due to ambiguity or environment-dependence.
